title: Lazy branches
text: Load teams on demand when a manager is expanded, with cancellation and timeouts.

title: Search and reveal
text: Find people by name or title and scroll them into view.

title: Zoom and fit
text: Pan, zoom, and fit the whole chart in vertical or horizontal layout.

title: Edit by moving
text: Move people to another manager with drag or keyboard, with undo and redo.

title: SVG and PNG export
text: Download the chart as an SVG or PNG image.
